name: startup-ip-skills
description: AI-agent skills that startup and SME development teams run on their own projects, by ABC IP LAW, a Korean patent and trademark firm.

plugins.name: abciplaw
plugins.displayName: ABC IP LAW Startup IP Skills (특허 포트폴리오 발굴 · 기술설명서 작성 · 선행상표 검색)
plugins.description: For startups and SMEs: (1) discover patent candidates from the codebase and business context, apply a preliminary patentability filter, design a portfolio, and write per-invention disclosures; (2) write a shareable technical disclosure for one chosen technology (problem, component-by-component solution, worked example, alternative embodiments, draft claim directions); (3) before filing a trademark, check distinctiveness, plan a KIPRIS search the user runs themselves, and assess the prior marks they bring back (Korean output by default).
